fullExplanation.text: Understanding Zephaniah in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life

Zephaniah provides the larger frame for Zephaniah in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life. An independent Catholic study of Zephaniah focused on day of the Lord, remnant, purification, judgment, and joy. Catholic method here moves from the inspired text to doctrinal judgment while also examining reception and reasoned scholarship.
